name: Coverbase
description:
Coverbase is the AI-native third-party risk management and procurement platform used by leading banks, credit unions, insurers, biotech, healthcare institutions, and Fortune 500 enterprises to run their vendor programs end to end.

The Coverbase connector brings your vendor portfolio into the conversation. Ask about vendors, assessments, findings, contracts, obligations, radar alerts, and audit trails, and get answers scoped to your Coverbase permissions.

Use it to:

- Pull a full risk profile for any vendor in a single call, including open findings, active assessments, contracts, obligations, and recent radar alerts.
- Map subprocessor exposure across your portfolio ("which of our vendors depend on AWS?") using SOC 2 disclosures and custom relationships.
- Summarize assessments and surface the controls that need human review.
- Run portfolio-wide reports: top risks, evidence health, review queue, assessment metrics.
- Track contracts expiring in the next 90 days and obligations coming due.
- Get a weekly program-health digest: recent assessments, open findings, radar alerts.
- Take write actions, gated by explicit user confirmation: add notes, create findings, start assessments, update vendor attributes.

The connector runs on your Coverbase account's OAuth 2.0 authentication and respects your role and permissions. It cannot see or modify anything you couldn't already see or modify in the Coverbase UI, and every write action requires explicit user confirmation before execution.

Coverbase is the modern vendor management solution trusted by top enterprises. Learn more at coverbase.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coverbase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coverbase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coverbase.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coverbase MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coverbase provides these MCP tools: get_report, mcp_capabilities, mutate, query_assessments, query_controls, query_engagements_contracts, query_findings, query_platform, query_questionnaires, query_radar, and query_vendors.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coverbase?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coverbase in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Coverbase requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coverbase is developed by Coverbase Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
